products.name: Avoma
products.note: Meeting intelligence AI; conversation analytics; coaching; revenue team data

profile_text.body:
Avoma is a software company that offers what it describes as an all-in-one AI platform covering note-taking, scheduling, and coaching, aimed at sales and revenue teams. The platform is designed to automate tasks such as meeting note-taking, email follow-ups, CRM data entry, lead qualification, and call scoring, with the company claiming users can save more than four hours per week through that automation. Avoma also positions the product around a usage-based pricing model, summarized on its site as paying only for what you need.

The platform's AI capabilities include a feature the company calls an AI Copilot for answering questions from meeting and call data, automated call scoring and personalized coaching, conversation analytics covering talk patterns and topic trends, and pipeline tools for deal and churn risk alerts, sales methodology tracking, and win-loss analysis. The site describes the scheduling component as enabling customers to book time with a team instantly through automated routing and qualification.

The site's held facts classify Avoma's product under the Notes, Knowledge and Meetings category, noting its focus on meeting intelligence, conversation analytics, coaching, and revenue team data. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
